description: Error-tracking issues (errors grouped by fingerprint) for a project, or across several with `projects`, with occurrences and affected users inside the window. Default: open issues (unresolved + regressed) sorted by occurrences over the last 14 days. Follow up with get_issue for the stack trace.

last.description: Relative window ending now, e.g. "1h", "24h", "7d", "30d", "90d". Default "14d". Ignored when `from` is given.

project.description: Project handle (as in list_projects) or id. Optional when this connection is limited to one project or the workspace has only one.

projects.description: Project handles (as in list_projects) or ids, to read across several apps. Leave out for every project this connection can reach. For one project use `project`; never pass both.

search.description: Matches title, error type or message.

name: list_issues
title: List issues
